transcript.answer: No, not any more. PR #2463 (merged 2026-10-02) added `.github/workflows/context-evals.yml`, which ran the evals every night at 03:17 UTC. PR #2823 (merged 2026-10-19) removed that workflow. The evals are now run by hand from a developer machine with `scripts/context-evals/run.mjs` against the deployed lore-api, and nothing runs them on a schedule. The reasons given were that the evals are experiments a person runs and writes up, and that the unattended run had gone red three nights in a row (10-17 to 10-19) on a single `demo-factory-todo` document that nobody read.

judgements.reason: The answer says the evals no longer run nightly and that they ran nightly from 2026-10-02 via #2463, which matches the gold answer; the extra detail does not contradict it.
